<parameter=code>
# Hypothesis: player position in box = joystick controlling the train.
# Move player to right edge (40,12) and see if train moves right.
def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        d[n['color']]=d.get(n['color'],[])+[(n['pixels'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))]
    return d
before = snap(current_frame)
action(['DOWN','RIGHT','RIGHT'])
after = snap(current_frame)
for k in set(before)|set(after):
    if before.get(k)!=after.get(k):
        print(k, before.get(k), '->', after.get(k))
print("done:", last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
